review_scope: Full normal-speed browser playback with receipt; sampled browser screenshots and native 1080p start, mid-descent and contact images. This is not continuous human visual inspection of all 192 frames.
observations: Actual opposite-side camera shows starboard flank and bow screen-right; the port pod remains on its physical far flank.
Forward travel is visible before the hold and vertical lowering; sampled end pose remains level and settled.
Opaque cones are absent. Short soft white-blue jets are visible below the hull during descent and absent at the end.
Weathered yard buildings and apron remain stable in the reviewed views; no exposed ground boundary strip or intersecting building was seen.
Major starboard bay, turret and engine landmarks remain attached to the moving hull in the sampled views.
limitations: Bounded side-view textured motion study, not complete arbitrary-angle UV coverage.
Some hull and yard RGB contains baked lighting and fine fixtures represented only in the surface art; relighting/camera changes need another coverage review.
Thrusters and dust are authored procedural volumes; no heat refraction, fluid simulation, audio or game-runtime integration.
Ground and contact construction evidence is finite sampled verification, not continuous collision or structural engineering.
